title: Action application commutes with left-block embedding
statement: Let $k,l$ be nonnegative integers, let $S,S'$ be state sets, and let $x$ be a finite Boolean input. Given a map $f:S\to S'$, a $k$-tape action $a$ with Boolean work-tape symbols and states in $S$, a configuration $c$ on input $x$ with $k$ work tapes and states in $S$, and arbitrary contents and head positions for $l$ additional tapes, applying the action extended to the first $k$ tapes with states renamed by $f$ to the left-block embedding of $c$ gives exactly the left-block embedding of the result of applying $a$ to $c$, with the same additional tape contents and head positions.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is an action with $k$ Boolean work tapes and states in $S$
$c$ is a configuration with $k$ Boolean work tapes and states in $S$ on Boolean input $x$
the contents of the additional $l$ tapes are arbitrary functions from $\mathbb Z$ to optional Boolean symbols
the head positions of the additional $l$ tapes are arbitrary integers
replaced:
Let $f : S \to S'$ be a state renaming, $a$ a one-step action of a machine
with $k$ work tapes over the Boolean alphabet, $c$ a configuration of such a
machine on input $x$, and fix contents and head positions for $l$ inactive
extra tapes.  Applying the left-block extension of $a$ along $f$ to the
left-block embedding of $c$ with the given inactive data yields the
left-block embedding, with the same inactive data, of the result of applying
$a$ to $c$.
